verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for an HR/payroll SaaS platform like Justworks, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a versioned public API or a documented deprecation policy. The "/api/v2" in the cited URLs belongs to the help-center search endpoint, not a Justworks product API, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.
